acceptance_status: Full automated-inventory checkpoint; complete functional/native/manual/performance/release parity remains open.
scope: Ten preference category controls share one Metal canvas, and header dismiss uses another. Rust PreferencesForm owns category selection, normalized UTF-16 query and row/section/navigation visibility. Native event/focus/AX, Unicode normalization, stores and browser services remain adapters.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency change. Rust bridge adds clear_selection for existing SelectState. Explicit native adapters, preference selector allocation/refresh and browser tests changed. Concurrent root network-policy work remains excluded.
build_input_snapshot.method: Committed archive with explicit prototype overrides, including page_dialogs.cc/h, and unchanged shared-service install/stage hooks, excluding concurrent root network-policy work. Final staging idempotent and Ninja no-work.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

additional_performance_scenario_coverage.purpose: Execute all four opt-in performance scenarios as additional automated coverage, with their default 30 trials. Metal validation is enabled; these are not controlled CPU/GPU/drawable presentation comparisons.

contracts: Rust owns category selection, query and visibility decisions; the C++ category field remains only for the Views backend. Native normalization supplies exactly the original trimmed/lowercased UTF-16 units. Invalid category IDs are rejected, searching clears active-navigation highlights, selecting even the same category clears search, and empty categories produce the original no-results behavior.

Dynamic rule display keywords are transferred fresh on each filter. No profile objects, permission/navigation authority or browser service mutation enters this Rust UI controller. Native profile/stale-confirmation/managed-setting checks remain unchanged.

Both backends use real Cocoa Space to select language settings, clear a camera search, switch between wide navigation and compact choice, and dismiss preferences. Selection, picker label and original field visibility stay synchronized.

Dedicated Metal coverage verifies ten childless category adapters in one group and a childless dismiss adapter, stable AX names/roles and scene text, profile/resize/hide cancellation, query/category retention and reappearance. The form is UI-only, with no browser/profile authority. Close/reopen and responsive selection/query retention are verified. Its ownership also survives view reconstruction, but a dedicated detach/reattach acceptance run was not added.

Rust analytic category/dismiss symbols replace native vector-icon painting, sharing the same clipped rectangle/circle recipe for Metal and CPU fallback. The original category semantic icon mapping and 200x40 row / 32x32 dismiss targets are retained; these are newly drawn symbols, not pixel-identical native icon paths.

Native View groups, placement, event/focus/AX and text normalization remain adapters. Preference headers/branding/sections/rows/status text, row surfaces, draft/admission/controller state and containers still have remaining native ownership.
limits: All original UI functionality is not yet proven migrated. Other forms/service panels, preference chrome/data/drafts/state, native interaction/container ownership and manual acceptance remain open.
RTL icon placement is unit checked, but full native RTL/complex bidi/scale/theme/VoiceOver/candidate-window/pointer/device-loss acceptance remains a separate requirement.
Optional default-30-trial scenarios add execution coverage with API validation; no controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation speedup is claimed.
Normal installed applications/profiles were untouched; no bundle was packaged/signed. No new crate/library/dependency. Final shipped-binary Apache-2.0/upstream notice acceptance remains open.

initial_compile_issues.rust: New recipe tests moved Item values into temporary arrays before modifying/reusing them. They now borrow with slice::from_ref.
initial_compile_issues.cpp: The category parent variable was deduced as PreferenceSurface*; its adapter container requires the base View* type.
